nodes.label: Content Security Policy
nodes.rationale: default-src 'self' with explicit allowances for https://*.paddle.com in script-src and frame-src. Without those entries initializePaddle() fails with 'Failed to load Paddle.js' and the checkout overlay never opens. frame-ancestors 'none' blocks clickjacking. Note script-src still permits 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval'.

nodes.label: SEO And Social Metadata
nodes.rationale: Open Graph and Twitter Card tags plus canonical https://cloudcore.lat/home. Positions CloudCore as a SaaS panel for VPS, WordPress, MySQL/PostgreSQL databases and SSH terminals. Authored by AbstracDev.

nodes.label: SPA Mount Point
nodes.rationale: Single #root div with a module script loading /src/main.tsx — the Vite entry point for the whole React app.
